concurrency_test: Paused catalog commit permits reads of the affected and unrelated inodes and native writes to another inode; conflicting mutations wait; release/forget pins survive through reply capture.
durability: Content manifest and binding remain FULL-durable before native retirement. The catalog permit is released after binding; the inode gate excludes mutations until retirement completes. Timestamp sync policy is unchanged.
retirement_test: Paused retirement blocks same-inode writes and hardlinks while another sealed inode hydrates, writes, and fsyncs; both mutation paths are observed waiting at the inode gate.
